source: 2016/TSB Vol 16 No 09 - Thumb Drive for Programming.pdf
title: Required Thumb Drives for Programming and Upgrading the Smart Tech Machines
lead: The MOC Smart Tech® machines (Transmission, Brake, and Engine Flush) have controller boards that are programmed using a specific program on a thumb drive. These programs can be updated in the field by plugging the thumb drive into the controller board. In order for the controller board to read the program, a specific type of thumb drive (Part No. 71247) is required.
body: Recommendation: the MOC Machine and Equipment Department recommends that all partners and distributors keep a minimum of 1 of these thumb drives in stock for servicing the Smart Tech® machines and controller boards, as needed. The new or updated program can be sent by email and transferred to thumb drive for a quick update. A controller board programmed for a certain machine may be reprogrammed for another machine if needed (special procedure required).
parts: Smart Tech® II ATF Controller board
